description: From XP's connected resale + primary order book. Use when a listing identifier is in hand and the user wants the full record for one open listing on the XP marketplace before they make an offer. Returns one row from the live offer book. Requires auth and read:bids scope. Do not use for casual ticket buyers; this is the seller-side and power-user marketplace surface. For standard ticket purchases, use `search_events` and `get_ticket_listings`.
name: get_open_listing
title: Get Open Listing
